title: Mindbody vs Glofox vs Custom: What Studios Should Run On

facts.fact: The Zee Palm article 'Mindbody vs Glofox vs Custom: What Studios Should Run On' is dated September 16, 2026.
The author recommends that studios with fewer than roughly 400 active members on one or two sites should not build custom studio software.
facts.quote: if you run fewer than roughly 400 active members on one or two sites, you should not build custom software.

facts.fact: The author states that the Glofox platform serves several thousand studios sharing one product roadmap.
facts.quote: If the request does not fit the roadmap for the other several thousand studios on the platform, it does not happen

facts.fact: In the page's comparison table, Mindbody's fixed monthly cost floor is described as a platform fee, seats/tiers, and processing.
In the page's comparison table, Glofox's fixed monthly cost floor is described as a platform fee, tiers, and processing.
In the page's comparison table, a custom build's fixed monthly cost floor is described as hosting plus maintenance.
The page states that Mindbody offers branded app upgrades only as a paid tier.
facts.quote: Branded upgrades exist as a paid tier

facts.fact: The page states that on Mindbody and Glofox, card-on-file payment tokens are held by the platform's processing arrangement rather than by the studio.
facts.quote: Held by the platform's processing arrangement

facts.fact: The page states that with a custom build, card-on-file payment tokens are held by the studio's own processor account.
facts.quote: Held by your own processor account

facts.fact: The page states that stored payment credentials on most platforms are not portable to a different processor as a matter of course.
facts.quote: they are not portable to a different processor as a matter of course

facts.fact: The page describes Mindbody as operating a consumer-facing discovery marketplace where members can find and book studios without visiting the studio's website.
facts.quote: Members can find studios there and book without ever having visited your website.
